name: vertical leg toe-reach crunch
description: A supine crunch with both legs raised and the arms reaching toward the toes, focusing on the abs.
instructions: Lie on your back and raise both legs together toward the ceiling.
Extend your arms toward your feet and brace your abdomen.
Curl your shoulders off the floor and reach toward your toes without jerking your neck.
Lower your shoulders slowly while keeping the legs controlled.
